scope: Documented independent Java/Spring and MySQL/MariaDB workflows on Windows; no claim of complete IntelliJ IDEA or DataGrip parity.
nodeEvidenceScope: Both complete actual Spring/database Node suites identify the same final source vector and VSIX; final source freshness is rechecked after each run.

nativeFixturePrecondition.description: After scripted Undo/save, document symbols and observed class-output membership and hashes settle for at least two seconds before each original API is invoked once. Production guards stay enabled. Intentional build-descriptor negative cases reach the original guard directly.

limitations: Bounded pure static/explicit-parameter instance members, flat Java packages and literal Gradle DAG/composite or Maven reactor dependencies; stateful/field/effectful receivers, nested package resources and arbitrary build logic remain incomplete.

Source-only hierarchy/overload plus bounded generic substitution, covariance, bounds, erasure and caller result checks; varargs, external/binary/framework and arbitrary dynamic clients remain unverified or refused.

Spring source contracts additionally resolve supported composed AliasFor and literal Import/selector/registration/identity processor forms; arbitrary computed/conditional extensions and runtime behavior remain unknown or refused.
ci: Maintainer-local validation is separate from the public Windows Node22 CI workflow. See this repository Actions for the actual result of each pushed commit.
